recent_observations.market_summary: U.S. equities had a strong risk-on session after a tentative U.S.-Iran agreement pushed crude oil sharply lower and compressed volatility, with the Nasdaq leading and the S&P 500 up roughly 1.7%-1.8%. The move was led by AI, semiconductor, storage, and travel beneficiaries, while energy lagged as crude fell toward $80. The session was a trend-up market for indexes, but our airline execution became choppy because UAL reversed from intraday strength while DAL failed the morning confirmation levels.
key_drivers: A tentative U.S.-Iran deal and expected Strait of Hormuz reopening drove oil lower and reduced inflation/geopolitical fear.
AI hardware and memory-shortage narratives powered AMD, MU, WDC, STX, and related chip/storage names.
The June 16-17 Fed meeting remained the next major macro catalyst, keeping a need for confirmation despite the risk-on close.

trades_review.assessment: The first entry was close to the planned breakout level, but it depended on DAL confirmation that deteriorated later in the session.
This add was still near the breakout level, but it duplicated exposure before the system proved the first entry could hold.
This was a chase into intraday strength and had the worst entry quality of the day.
This second high-price add compounded the chase instead of waiting for support or a fresh confirmation signal.
The price was acceptable, but repeated re-entry after a reversal showed no position-level throttle.
The entry was near the trigger but came while the journal itself noted inconsistent confirmation.
This add bought another intraday pop despite DAL having already failed the intended confirmation role.
This was a duplicate momentum add at an extended price with no new risk budget justification.
The entry was less extended, but it still increased a losing concentrated position.
This late add ignored the repeated journal warning that DAL confirmation was incomplete.
The final add was at the snapshot price but still increased exposure after the position-level thesis had weakened.

patterns_detected.notes: Multiple monitor cycles added UAL even when the recommendation was hold or when no new entry was needed, growing one trade to 57% invested and ending down 1.7%.

patterns_detected.name: sympathy_confirmation_decay
patterns_detected.notes: The UAL long depended on DAL maintaining gains, but DAL repeatedly failed $85.80 and $86.20 while UAL exposure kept rising.

patterns_detected.name: volume_filter_prevented_jbl_chase
patterns_detected.notes: JBL held support and neared the trigger, but weak 0.1x-0.7x relative volume kept the system out ahead of earnings.

confidence_calibration.assessment: Executed UAL exposure was mostly attached to medium/high confidence reads, but all filled lots were flat-to-negative at the profile snapshot; there was no meaningful low-confidence executed sample.

missed_opportunities.why_missed: The morning watchlist identified WDC but left it watch-only; the system required a pullback/reclaim and had no storage-leader escalation rule for a sector-wide memory breakout.
MU was correctly identified as a memory-shortage beneficiary but stayed watch-only because of quote precision concerns and the absence of a post-open breadth trigger.
AMD was a morning best opportunity, but execution shifted to UAL and did not revisit AMD's confirmed risk-on semiconductor setup after the open.

recent_observations.forward_outlook: Tomorrow should prioritize confirmed AI hardware and memory/storage leadership over airline sympathy unless airlines hold gains without DAL divergence. Watch the June 16-17 Fed meeting, any deterioration in the U.S.-Iran framework, crude holding near or below $80, and Jabil's June 17 earnings setup; UAL needs a position-level stop/throttle before any further adds.
lessons: A sympathy trade should stop adding when its confirmation symbol fails; UAL exposure should have been capped once DAL lost $85.80 and failed to reclaim $86.20.
Hold recommendations must not translate into new buy orders for an already-open position; the system needs an explicit add-only signal.
In a broad risk-on trend day, the strongest sector confirmation was semiconductors/storage, not the airline leg that faded intraday.

patterns.name: duplicate_buy_on_existing_position
patterns.description: Repeated monitor cycles convert an already-open position into additional buy orders without a distinct add setup.
patterns.notes: UAL was bought eleven times and finished with -1.70% unrealized P&L despite multiple hold/no-duplicate warnings.

patterns.name: sympathy_confirmation_decay
patterns.description: A trade relies on a related confirmation symbol, then that confirmation fades while exposure in the primary symbol continues to rise.
patterns.notes: UAL long thesis depended on DAL maintaining gains, but DAL failed $85.80 and $86.20 repeatedly.

patterns.name: volume_filter_prevented_jbl_chase
patterns.description: A breakout watchlist name holds support but lacks required relative volume before an earnings catalyst, keeping the profile out.
patterns.notes: JBL stayed watch-only as relative volume remained 0.1x-0.7x before June 17 earnings; outcome remains pending rather than proven.

proposals.title: Track Sympathy Confirmation Decay
proposals.description: UAL depended on DAL remaining strong, but DAL lost the required levels while UAL continued to be accumulated. Store cross-symbol confirmation failures as a reusable pattern.
proposals.expected_impact: Helps future airline, cruise, and sector-pair trades exit or stop adding when the confirmation leg fails.

proposals.title: Require Live Catalyst Inputs For Commodity-Linked Trades
proposals.description: XOM decisions repeatedly stalled because live WTI confirmation was missing or inconsistent, even though crude was the core catalyst. Add a reliable intraday WTI/Brent feed to the monitor context.
proposals.expected_impact: Reduces hesitation on valid oil-linked shorts and prevents trades when the commodity catalyst cannot be verified.

proposals.title: Escalate Confirmed Sector Leaders After The Open
proposals.description: The morning research correctly identified AMD, MU, and WDC as memory/AI beneficiaries, but the system did not rotate back to them after the sector confirmed with large moves. Add a post-open sector breadth scan that promotes watch-only names when multiple related leaders break out on volume.
proposals.expected_impact: Improves participation in the strongest theme of the day instead of over-focusing on a weaker sympathy setup.

proposals.title: Add Position-Level Exposure Throttle
proposals.description: UAL grew to 57% invested in a single intraday thesis while the confirmation signal weakened. Add per-symbol and per-thesis caps, plus a cooldown after a position flips from positive to negative P&L.
proposals.expected_impact: Keeps one deteriorating setup from dominating account-level P&L and would have limited the final -0.98% portfolio hit.

proposals.title: Separate Hold From Add Signals
proposals.description: Today the profile accumulated UAL repeatedly even when monitor reports said to hold or explicitly said not to duplicate the active position. Add a hard execution gate that only places a new order when the recommendation is buy, ready_to_trade is true, the symbol is not already at its max position budget, and an explicit add_reason is present.
proposals.expected_impact: Prevents one valid entry from becoming eleven correlated orders and would have materially reduced today's UAL drawdown.
